PLAINTIFF BING QIN LIN, ASSISTED BY PROVISIONALLY QUALIFIED CANTONESE INTERPERTER REBACCA CHAU, IS PRESENT. SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-15-2020 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LIN, BING QIN IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT LIN, JIAN PLAINTIFF BING QIN LIN, FAILED TO PROVE DEFENDANT JIAN LIN STOLE PROPERTY AND MONEY FROM PLAINTIFF. ALSO DEFENDANT OBTAINED A JUDGMENT AGAINST PLAINTIFF ON SEPTEMBER 11, 2019 FOR $4,780.00 (CSM-19-860797) WHICH IS UNPAID BECAUSE MR. BING QIN LIN KEPT PROPERTY BELONGING TO JIAN LIN.
